items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: I think one time we had this boy play, Lonnie Johnson was on the show.

ctx.x: I mean it wasn't just a part of the show, it was the whole thing. The whole thing, that's right. And you all traveled by bus. By bus, we had a bus. They have other acts and dancers and other singers I guess. That's right.
I think one time we had this boy play, Lonnie Johnson was on the show.
Oh, he was. I knew him in Chicago, out west.
